canvas.responsive_rule: Keep essential labels in the central safe area, use no more than six visual clusters per page, and preserve legibility on mobile, tablet and laptop screens.

concepts.title: Reading the IUCN status ladder
concepts.concept_direction: A clean ascending risk trail from LC to EX, with VU–EN–CR enclosed as the threatened zone and CR clearly separated from EX.
concepts.full_direction: A landscape-to-extinction visual journey explaining each status step, the threatened-category bracket, and the CR versus EX exam trap in four compact clusters.

concepts.title: How IUCN criteria diagnose extinction risk
concepts.concept_direction: Five diagnostic lenses labelled A–E around one species: decline, range, small declining population, very small population, quantitative probability.
concepts.full_direction: A visual decision laboratory showing that any applicable criterion can qualify a taxon, with A1 versus A2–A4 thresholds and the ten-years-or-three-generations clock.

concepts.title: Project, Recovery Programme and Action Plan
concepts.concept_direction: Three distinct toolboxes: funded implementation project, targeted species recovery programme, and policy action-plan roadmap.
concepts.full_direction: A compare-and-apply scene showing purpose, authority, time horizon and typical output of each instrument without implying that the labels are legal categories.

concepts.title: Project Tiger and the AITE evidence chain
concepts.concept_direction: A tiger-reserve landscape linked to NTCA governance and an evidence chain of signs, camera traps, genetics and habitat surveys.
concepts.full_direction: Timeline from Project Tiger 1973 to NTCA and the fifth AITE 2022, separating 3,682 and the NTCA FAQ estimate/range by source and distinguishing AITE from M-STrIPES.

concepts.title: Tiger roles, dispersal and carrying capacity
concepts.concept_direction: One tiger at the centre of four ecological-role icons, beside a young disperser moving through a corridor beyond a reserve.
concepts.full_direction: Explain apex, keystone, umbrella and flagship roles, then contrast normal territorial dispersal with evidence actually needed before inferring carrying-capacity pressure.

concepts.title: Project Elephant, estimation and corridor conflict
concepts.concept_direction: An elephant herd moving from habitat through a protected corridor, with conservation, welfare, estimation and conflict-response icons.
concepts.full_direction: Project Elephant 1992 objectives, the dated SAIEE estimate and range, why methods affect comparability, and how fragmentation converts traditional movement into conflict.

concepts.title: Asiatic lions beyond protected-area boundaries
concepts.concept_direction: A Greater Gir landscape with lions inside and outside the reserve boundary, plus a dated 2020-to-2025 count marker.
concepts.full_direction: Show 674 to 891, persistence of single-landscape risk, Project Lion versus Kuno translocation, and habitat expansion toward Barda as separate ideas.

concepts.title: Cheetah reintroduction and a moving population total
concepts.concept_direction: A 1952 absence marker followed by African source routes to Kuno and Gandhi Sagar, with a prominent date-tag attached to the population counter.
concepts.full_direction: Explain why the operation is reintroduction, source countries, multi-site risk spreading, grassland value, and why births, deaths and transfers require as-of dates.

concepts.title: Finding snow leopards in high mountains
concepts.concept_direction: A Himalayan survey scene combining camera-trap grids and scat genetics around an elusive snow leopard.
concepts.full_direction: SPAI fieldwork and release dates, 718 estimate and Ladakh share, method suitability, Project Snow Leopard versus GSLEP, and the principal threat chain.

concepts.title: What the river-dolphin estimate actually counts
concepts.concept_direction: River, estuary and sea habitats under Project Dolphin, with the 6,327 counter confined visually to the surveyed river systems.
concepts.full_direction: Separate project scope from census scope, map the Ganga–Brahmaputra–Indus coverage, and show how the 2026 repeat begins a comparable time series.

concepts.title: Gharial ecology and Project Crocodile
concepts.concept_direction: A deep-river gharial feeding on fish beside the egg-to-hatchery-to-release conservation cycle.
concepts.full_direction: Compare gharial, mugger and saltwater crocodile status; explain the 1975 partnership, head-starting workflow, release record and uneven recovery.

concepts.title: Three recovery lessons: vultures, bustards and release terms
concepts.concept_direction: Three-panel visual: diclofenac-to-vulture collapse, power-line-to-bustard collision, and a destination-status fork for reinforcement versus reintroduction.
concepts.full_direction: Trace each causal threat and response, include dated plan/captive totals, and use a destination-population decision path to distinguish reinforcement, reintroduction and introduction.

concepts.title: Diagnosing and responding to human–wildlife conflict
concepts.concept_direction: A conflict-response wheel connecting crop loss, livestock loss and direct encounters to prevention, warning, compensation and rapid response.
concepts.full_direction: Explain the 2021–2026 national strategy and Andhra Pradesh H.A.N.U.M.A.N. as a field-response network, while showing why different losses require different remedies.

concepts.title: Choose the monitoring method for the question
concepts.concept_direction: A field scientist routes four questions to camera traps, line transects, genetics and telemetry, with M-STrIPES shown as patrol intelligence rather than census alone.
concepts.full_direction: A six-cluster method-selection guide linking abundance, occupancy, identity, movement, habitat and patrol questions to evidence and explaining M-STrIPES modules.

concepts.title: Large mammals: status, habitat and conservation action
concepts.concept_direction: Five habitat portraits for tiger, elephant, Asiatic lion, one-horned rhino and snow leopard with compact IUCN–CITES–Indian-law badges.
concepts.full_direction: Five equal visual clusters compare status, core habitat, principal threat and flagship action without turning the page into a text table.

concepts.title: Threatened grassland, river and marine specialists
concepts.concept_direction: A connected habitat strip for Great Indian Bustard, gharial, Ganges dolphin and dugong, with each species placed in its ecological niche.
concepts.full_direction: Four species stories connect legal status, habitat specialization, key threat and recovery response; duplicate dugong ledger facts share one primary visual home.

concepts.title: Trafficking, poisoning, rarity and mass nesting
concepts.concept_direction: Four illustrated species scenes: pangolin burrow, vulture at a safe carcass, nocturnal courser in scrub and olive ridley arribada.
concepts.full_direction: Four causal mini-stories explain status, range, dominant threat and conservation response, including the ecology behind each vulnerability.

concepts.title: Endemic species and specialised habitats
concepts.concept_direction: Three habitat portraits: Seshachalam red sanders, tall-grass pygmy hog and Western Ghats Nilgiri tahr.
concepts.full_direction: Explain how restricted range and habitat dependence raise risk, then contrast trade control, grassland management and montane-habitat recovery.

concepts.title: Forest canopy, grassland and rocky-slope conservation
concepts.concept_direction: A Western Ghats canopy, open grassland and Seshachalam rocky slope host lion-tailed macaque, blackbuck and Cycas beddomei, with an AP locator inset.
concepts.full_direction: Three habitat-linked species accounts plus an Andhra Pradesh endemic-range synthesis, keeping global status, trade controls and Indian protection visually distinct.

concepts.title: National Wildlife Action Plan 2017–2031
concepts.concept_direction: A 2017–2031 roadmap radiating from species protection to landscapes, climate resilience, marine systems, conflict management and participation.
concepts.full_direction: A strategy-to-field-action flow showing the third NWAP's broad framework, its non-statutory policy role and how themes translate into coordinated conservation.

concepts.title: Recent conservation initiatives: dates and purposes
concepts.concept_direction: A clean 2025–2026 timeline with four Wildlife Week initiatives, the HWC Centre and Andhra Pradesh H.A.N.U.M.A.N. grouped by launch event.
concepts.full_direction: Six visual clusters distinguish announcement, inauguration and launch; show responsible institution, purpose and the danger of merging similarly timed initiatives.

concepts.title: Reading dated wildlife estimates responsibly
concepts.concept_direction: A dashboard of tiger, elephant, lion and river-dolphin estimates, each locked to a survey name, year, method or range rather than shown as timeless counters.
concepts.full_direction: Six compact evidence cards explain source differences, uncertainty ranges, repeated lion and dolphin ledger facts, and why cross-cycle percentage comparisons can mislead.

concepts.title: Counts, plan cycles and the IBCA milestone
concepts.concept_direction: Three dated panels: protected-area-network counts, action-plan period bars, and the IBCA treaty-entry milestone.
concepts.full_direction: Teach fixed status versus date-sensitive count, expired versus verified-current plan, and announcement versus legal entry into force through three parallel timelines.

concepts.title: MISHTI: mangroves, shoreline and livelihoods
concepts.concept_direction: A mangrove cross-section linking roots, shoreline protection, nursery habitat, carbon and community livelihood.
concepts.full_direction: Explain the acronym, 2023–24 announcement, convergence-based implementation and the ecological-to-livelihood pathway without implying a new legal protected-area category.

concepts.title: Amrit Dharohar at existing Ramsar Sites
concepts.concept_direction: An already-designated Ramsar wetland surrounded by community skills, nature tourism, livelihoods and wetland stewardship.
concepts.full_direction: Show the three-year scheme's capacity-building and participation logic and clearly separate Ramsar designation from the later livelihood-support programme.

concepts.title: Three systems, three different questions
concepts.concept_direction: Three lenses focus on one species: extinction risk, international trade and protection under Indian law.
concepts.full_direction: A case-based comparison of assessor, geographic scope, legal force and meaning, ending with examples showing why labels cannot be substituted for one another.

concepts.title: CITES trade controls through three species
concepts.concept_direction: Star tortoise, red sanders and pangolin beside Appendix I/II gates, with legal regulated trade separated from trafficking.
concepts.full_direction: A CoP timeline and trade-control flow explain the 2019, 1994 and 2016 milestones, Appendix meanings, seizure evidence and why dated enforcement data are not permanent status.

concepts.title: International Big Cat Alliance
concepts.concept_direction: Seven big cats encircle a cooperation globe, with the five Old World/India-occurring cats separated from jaguar and puma of the Americas.
concepts.full_direction: A treaty timeline from announcement to Cabinet approval, entry into force and headquarters agreement; explain functions, seven-species scope, range-country figure and postponed summit.

concepts.title: Operation Olivia: protecting nesting waters
concepts.concept_direction: Indian Coast Guard surface and aerial patrols protect Odisha's olive-ridley nesting waters while a turtle escapes a trawl through a TED.
concepts.full_direction: A November-to-May operational cycle connects patrols, seasonal trawling restrictions and Turtle Excluder Devices to reduced drowning risk, with ministry ownership explicit.

concepts.title: National Marine Turtle Action Plan 2021–2026
concepts.concept_direction: A sea-turtle life corridor links nesting beach, offshore habitat, entanglement response, rehabilitation, research and community participation.
concepts.full_direction: Show the 28 January 2021 release, plan pillars, companion stranding guidelines, agency coordination and the need to verify a successor after the stated 2026 endpoint.

concepts.title: Place-based recovery programmes across India
concepts.concept_direction: An India map links Hangul–Dachigam, Sangai–Keibul Lamjao, rhino–Manas, dugong–Palk Bay and Nilgiri tahr–Western Ghats in five illustrated habitat windows.
concepts.full_direction: Five compact place-species-programme clusters distinguish state, multi-partner and legal-reserve arrangements, and apply reintroduction versus reinforcement correctly.
